63184.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63184.question_text:
(a) State the six general procedures for taking cash payment in a catering establishment.

(b) State two qualities of a supervisor in a catering establishment.
63184.explanation:
(a) General Procedures for Taking Cash Payment in a Catering Establishment:

(i) Enter the price of each item in an invoice/billing machine.

(il) Confirm/crosscheck the entered bill.

(iii) Total the items and inform customer.

(iv) Enter the value of the money given by customer/check the cash received in front of the customer to avoid counterfeit.

(v) Count the change and hand it over to customer.

(vi) Receipt should always accompany the change.

(b) Qualities of a Supervisor in a Catering Establishment. Ability to:

(i) Positively motivate subordinates.

(ii) Make informed decisions.

(ili) Coordinate activities

(iv) Organize/ plan activities.

(v) Communicate effectively.

(vi) Mediate among staff.

(vii) Inspire other staff

(viii) Initiate good ideas.

(ix) Have good organizational skills.

(×) Have good physical stamina.

(xi) Delegate authority.

(xil) Manage time.

(xiii) Identify potentials of subordinates. (

xiv) Be punctual.

63189.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63189.question_text:
Give the meaning of the following terms used in the hospitality industry.

(a) Check-in; 

(b) Reservation;

(c) Forecast;

(d) Walk-in.
63189.explanation:
(a) Meaning of the Following Terms Used in the Hospitality Industry;

(i) Check-in: The process of greeting and registering a guest, verifying the method of payment and dispensing room keys.

(ii) Reservation: Order/arrangement made for any service in the hospitality industry to be used at a later time/advance booking OR Blocking a particular room type for a guest, for a definite period of time.

(iii) Forecast: A projection/prediction of future patronage in any service in the hospitality industry.

(iv) Walk-in: A guest who arrives in a hotel without reservation/advance booking OR a guest/customer who arrives at a hotel without prior booking OR a term used in the hotel for customer/guest who comes in without advance booking.

63196.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63196.question_text:
(a) State four points to consider when selecting and serving beverages.

(b) Highlight four characteristics of alcoholic beverages.
63196.explanation:
(a) Points to Consider when Selecting and Serving Beverages:

(i) The nutritional need of the individual.

(ii) The time of the day.

(ili) The health condition of the individual.

(iv) The weather condition of the place.

(v) The type of work done by the individual.

(vi) The age of the individual.

(vi) Dry wine should be served before sweet wine.

(viii) White wine should be served before red wine.

(ix) Lighter wine should be served before heavier wine.

(x) Good wine should be served before great wine.

(b) Characteristics of Alcoholic Beverages:

(i) Contain fermented sugar.

(ii) Nutritive value is low.

(iii) Have strong flavor/strong beverage.

(iv) Act as sedative when consumed excessively.

(v) Always ready to serve. (vi) Easily addicted to.

63210.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63210.question_text:
(a) State four features of a good cake.

(b) State four defects that could occur in cakes.
63210.explanation:
(a) Features of a Good Cake:

-It should be fluffy/light in weight.

-The flavor should be pleasing.

-It should be soft in texture/not hard.

-It should be golden brown in colour.

-The shape should not crumble when cutting/good shape.

-The skewer comes out clean when used in testing

-It should not be burnt.

-It should not be too oily

-It should not be damp.

-It should bounce back when pressed lightly

(b) Defects that could occur in cakes:

-Close/heavy/hard texture.

-Uneven texture.

-Cracks in cake.

-Bad shape.

-Dry cake.

-Uneven browning

-Sunken cake/cake sunk in the middle/not rising.

-Coarse texture.

-Holes in the cake.

-Burnt cake

-Crumbled/breaking texture.

63215.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63215.question_text:
(a) List four ingredients for making pineapple drink.

(b) In four points, state the procedures for preparing pineapple drink.
63215.explanation:
(a) Ingredients for Making Pineapple Drink:

(i) Pineapple. (li) Water/ice block. (ill) Sugar/syrup. (iv) Spice/flavouring/ginger.

(b) Procedures for Preparing Pineapple Drink:

(i) Prepare the syrup.

(ii) Wash the pineapple with clean water and peel.

(iii) Cut into pieces, blend/grate and strain.

(iv) Add syrup, flavouring, refrigerate and serve.

63217.subject: Catering Craft Practice
63217.question_text:
(a) Give four methods of preserving fish.

(b) In a restaurant, a customer has lodged a complaint that her beef dish is not well cooked. In four steps, outline how the situation should be managed.
63217.explanation:
(a) Methods of Preserving Fish:

(i) Smoking. (ii) Drying. (in) Freezing. (iv) Salting. (v) Fermentation.

(vi) Canning. (vii) Pickling.

 

(b) Steps on How to Manage the Complaint of a Customer who Reported that her Beef was not Well Cooked:

(i) Empathize and feel concerned.

(ii) Apologize to the customer.

(iii) Remove the ood and return it to the kitchen.

(iv) Ask the customer if she wants the food replaced or choose another alternative.

(v) Collect the new dish and serve immediately.

(vi) Apologize for any inconveniences caused.

(vii) Follow up to ensure the customer is satisfied
